mood: Cold, lonely and tense: a dead mining rig humming in the dark, with a glitching ghost at the end of the corridor.

shape.borderStyle: 1px solid border; cyan glow ring on focus
shape.texture: faint scanlines plus occasional glitch slices

buttonStyle: Primary is a flat cyan outline button with cyan text that fills with 15% cyan on hover; secondary is a plain text button with an amber bracket marker. Disabled controls fade to muted ink.
backdrop: Slowly zooming CSS corridor of nested rectangles with cyan edges and two amber lamps, plus a few drifting dust specks; a magenta/cyan glitch bar slides across the title once every ~10 s.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
